note: The household of Miss Rachael Procter Hutchinson on the 1891 return, transcribed by A. Hagues and placed at 7 Lenton Road (#180) from Wright's Directory of Nottingham, which prints 'Miss Rachel Hutchinson' at 7 Lenton Road in 1894-95 and 1898-99, and 'Hutchinson Miss Rachel Procter' there in 1910-11, 1913-14 and 1915-16. The year is taken as 1891 from the page this transcription came with; the ages fit it. None of the four was in the record, and 7 Lenton Road held no census before 1921. The census spells her Rachael, the directory Rachel. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way.
source: 1891 census, Lenton Road, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1894-95, page 84 (Leicester Special Collections id 164590); 1898-99, page 92 (id 165268); 1910-11, page 123 (id 165799).
